name: Butanamide, 4-amino- (9CI)
summary: Gabamide, or GABAmide, also known as γ-aminobutyramide (GABAD), is a GABA receptor agonist and GABA analogue, or more specifically the amide of the inhibitory neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA).002). Unlike progabide, but similarly to GABA, gabamide is unable to cross the blood–brain barrier and hence is peripherally selective.

pharmacology.text: Gabamide, or GABAmide, also known as γ-aminobutyramide (GABAD), is a GABA receptor agonist and GABA analogue, or more specifically the amide of the inhibitory neurotransmitter γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA). Along with GABA and progabide acid (SL-75.102), gabamide is an active metabolite of the anticonvulsant drug progabide (Gabrene; SL-76.002).

summaryZh: 4-氨基丁醯胺是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C4H10N2O，為γ-氨基丁酸的類似物。

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study GABA receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究 GABA 受體的研究用化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究 GABA 受体的研究用化合物，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is GABA, the brain's main calming transmitter, with its acid group turned into an amide. That small change makes the molecule neutral instead of charged, which affects how it moves around the body.
fact.zh: 它是把大腦主要抑制性傳訊物質 GABA 的酸性基團轉變為醯胺的產物。這個小改動使分子從帶電變為中性，從而影響它在體內的移動方式。
fact.zhHans: 它是把大脑主要抑制性传讯物质 GABA 的酸性基团转变为酰胺的产物。这个小改动使分子从带电变为中性，从而影响它在体内的移动方式。
